beats: Our kids could only see today's events on the kitchen kiosk calendar — nothing later in the week.
A scrolling ticker felt like a TV news crawl — too busy for a screen meant to be glanced at.
Paging through events was calmer, but it still shifted every few seconds.
I even doubled the backend window on Cloudflare Workers, from one week to two.
What finally worked was text that holds still — two weeks of family events, right there on screen.
